headline: Microsoft Quantum advertises system-wide AMS simulation and shared modeling methodology
fact: Microsoft posted a Senior Quantum Analog Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer role assigning the Quantum 1st Party Hardware ASIC team system-wide AMS models, simulation environments and test plans. It combines analog and digital blocks across multiple SoCs, supplies behavioral models to full-chip digital verification, and establishes standardized AMS verification/modeling methodology with peers. Qualifications include UVM/OVM, Spectre AMS or Synopsys XA, and modeling corners and process variability. AI-tool use is a general work requirement rather than a specified model-generation method. This records an advertised infrastructure mandate, not deployed quantum-SoC verification results.

sources.title: Microsoft employer LinkedIn: Senior Quantum Analog Mixed-Signal Verification Engineer
sources.summary: Full employer-attributed posting and current JobPosting metadata give October 12, 2026. Duties explicitly cover shared AMS methodology, cross-SoC simulation and analog behavioral models for digital verification. No particular HDL or measured AI-generated modeling result is disclosed.
